lines: Each world you ride is kept on this device, so the next ride opens in seconds, even offline. This device shows what is kept.
Saved worlds reads how many, how much space they take, and names them: three worlds, sixty-one megabytes.
Clear saved worlds deletes them. The row reads None saved, and a toast says how much was freed, then closes on its own.
Keep worlds after a ride is on by default. Turn it off, and nothing new is saved: the next ride downloads the world again.
This device, from a phone to the full screen.
And if the browser clears space on its own, World loading simply downloads the world again. Nothing fails.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
